title: birds.cafe: a browser experience where you steer a flock of seagulls through day, night

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: No missions, no score, no stress. Birds.cafe just lets you fly. It's a relaxing browser experience where you steer a flock of seagulls in V formation out over the ocean through day, night, rain, storms, and lightning with ambient music underneath. Built-in 3JS with physics-based flight.
